title: EARP per-query outcome (earp.per-query.v1)
description: One JSON object per line of earp.per-query.v1.jsonl -- one line per (query, K). Only outcome=scored carries metric numbers; skipped, blocked, and error carry a reason and no score, and are never folded into a recall denominator as an ordinary miss.

query_id.description: Immutable gold query id. Comparison pairing keys on this.

k.description: The K rung for retrieval rows; null EXACTLY for answer-arm rows (S9), whose outcome is K-independent. Additive-nullable, same no-bump rule.

blocker_code.description: Set when outcome is 'blocked'; matches the result sidecar's blocker vocabulary.

supporting_coverage.description: null when the query has no supporting units -- the reference returns Option<f64>. null means inapplicable, NOT a zero score.

abstained.description: Negative-class queries only: correct iff top-K returned nothing.

stratum.description: Populated when comparison.strata declares 'query_class' (the whole v1 vocabulary): the query's gold query_class.

arm.description: S8. The arm this row was measured under (comparison/sweep campaigns only; absent for single-scenario campaigns).

answer_outcome.description: S9 answer-arm rows only. PerClassScorer semantics: correct/correct_abstention score 1.0; incorrect, abstained_miss (abstention against a positive), and false_positive (an answered negative) score 0.0. Never folded into a retrieval recall denominator.

answer_text_sha.description: S9. sha256 of the (normalized) answer text; null when the answerer abstained. The text itself never lands in the sidecar.

answer_reason.description: S9. Populated on non-scored answer rows (error/halt); null on scored ones.
